notes.content:
Kodon is Now Available on Steam!

Kodon is a 3D sculpting software for VR and Desktop with an intuitive interface that allows even inexperienced users to create 3D models in a 3D space.

notes.title: Another big update on stability and user experience
notes.content:

[list]
[*] Fixed some of the most problematic errors relating to undo and multiobject

notes.title: UI, helpers, tooltips, major stability fixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25177104/e1fe2a59668601916cb1cff2a17de3b8d3899a40.png[/img]

Hey guys, thanks to all for holding out and waiting for the good stuff.

This is our second major update for 2023, now focusing heavily on stability within file handling, multiobject handling and undo.

We've started our UI revamp, focusing primarily on making it easy for new users to understand and explore Kodon (yes Kodon has been really tricky to understand, sorry about that). More is coming here!

With regards to headset compatibility, we've added direct support for OVR - the Meta Quest headset drivers (including some very early Quest Link features), so remember to set your active runtime to Oculus for this to kick in.

We've fixed a major bug on PICO and Valve Index headsets, as well as having made numerous adaptations to the individual headsets.

Join us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/Esr5wgkGvA]Discord [/url] and tell us if something works poorly! It is really really important to independent devs like us to help you out while getting important test data.

notes.title: Feel, speed and stability improvements
notes.content:
Hello all,

Most people following Kodons development (mostly on Discord) know what we've been doing since June - working hard day and night to stabilize and finalize the new GPU engine.

Recently, we've getting consistent feedback from testers that the code has had significant speed and stability improvements, and we see from statistics that the tool is used more frequently by more users. The build connected to this announcement summarizes that quite well. For us, it is all about our users experience of flow and feel and enjoyment of creating.

Obviously, our work is not done. Core features still remain, and many bugs will be discovered. But we believe Kodon is a tool you can both try and use. It is very close to meeting the standards you and we expect from it.

Hopefully you guys will test this versionout, cheer for us and follow us in the coming period.

Come to our Discord (https :// discord.gg / 9NB8Kzz7) if something doesn't work, and we fill follow you up and figure it out! If we can crack your bugs, it is helpful for us, you and everyone else.

notes.title: The Progress Rating
notes.content:
[b]Hi friends![/b]

We want to give a warm thank you to everyone who has been patient for Kodon, as well as an update on how things turned out before Christmas and the way forward. 

There were several reasons behind the postponement of V1.0 release, one of them is that Steam advised us not to go out of Early Access near/on the Winter Sale, since it would not be beneficial in terms of visibility, but the most important reason is that several of you advised us to wait to make sure that everything was good before release. 

We have an internal rating system that allows us to estimate the state of a build. These are the internal ratings we had by Christmas, compared with our current ratings:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25177104/540a2e081f7fa289fe55f3c55a67bfa302350d31.png[/img]

We initially planned to allow a lower rating on the voxel engine, but we changed our minds because this is very central to Kodon. That being said, [b]for the next build, our target state is 7.5/10, except for the voxel engine, which might be provided as optional, or excluded.[/b]
[b]For release, our target state is 9/10, except for the voxel engine at 7/10.[/b]

I hope this clears things up a bit more when it comes to where we are in development. We of course want to make it happen as soon as possible, but most of all, we want to deliver a product everyone will want to use. 

Thanks again for being part of this journey. We will keep you updated with more Progress Ratings as development advances. 

[b]Brianda <3[/b]

notes.title: Major Kodon update: GPU based tools and Multiresolution
notes.content:
[b]Hi there Kodon enthusiasts![/b] 

Like mentioned on the title, we have changed the way Kodon fundamentally works, trying to make a significant improvement on performance by utilizing the power of the GPU. 
The sculpting process now takes place here! 

Here's what you can expect in regards to changes:
[list]
[*] Multiresolution
[*] GPU Accelerated sculpting tools (Tool speed is ALOT faster, this is the biggest improvement)
[*] Brush Feel Greatly improved (Our second biggest improvement)
[*] Improved Lighting
[*] FBX, OBJ Import export improvements (vertex color)
[*] Insert Mesh brush (Great for concepting)
[*] UI improvements, including object naming (another update with bigger changes here is expected to be ready very soon)
[/list]
This update has unfortunately still some issues in the following criteria:
[list]
[*] Remesh
[*] Conversion
[*] Symmetry
[*] Multiresolution
[*] Model Room is mostly unchanged: no changes on UI or bugs in this room.
[/list]
[b]Cloth Sim is currently unavailable[/b] in this update as we restructure Kodon and we hope to fix these issues in following builds, however, if you opt into the [b]previous_version[/b] branch you can find cloth there.

Please give this a try and send any feedback that you may encounter our way. Don't hesitate to let us know everything: from bugs and aspects that are unintuitive to the things you love from this version so we know not to mess with them! 
Write to us here on the discussions or on any of our Social Media platforms. We'll try to engage as much as possible. And one thing, if you like this update, please let others know so in the reviews! Help us spread the word that Kodon is growing! 

Have a great week everyone! 

Brianda <3

[B]SteamVR-Oculus integration issues - "grey room"[/B]

We are using SteamVR to provide support for Oculus users. In some versions, this can cause issues outside our control.

Enabling "direct mode" can also fix this problem.

notes.title: Kodon description changed
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25177104/1cd0a38f41050809cf09d9d181687b8779357949.jpg[/img]

[i]To thank our faithful and patient supporters, here's a 3D-printed gecko.[/i]

Sales are nice - they bring in a lot of new interested people and push people who have been waiting for a while, over the edge to make a purchase.

Unfortunately, people who buy at sales also seem to have a greater tendency to leave negative reviews - so after the Winter sale, Kodons review score has quickly gone from ~90% to now 76%.

Of course, part of this is due to our delayed updating of the main branch as well, leaving a main version that is more flawed than usual. (truth be told)

Most negative reviews are unfortunately in misunderstanding of what Early Access means, or people without the correct specs and have an expectation from VR apps that they work instantly and fluently.

So we felt forced to change the Kodon description to make things even more clear. The things we have added to it:

1) Kodon is an Early Access app, meaning it is like a Kickstarter project, only you can actually use it a little bit before its done. It's not considered to be a finished product quite yet. Expected completion is around March / April 2017

2) Early Access means "under development" or "pre release", which again translates to "alpha builds". So - expect crashing and various mistakes. Sorry! Please be patient with us :)

3) To compensate for this under development aspect, we provide several parallel branches for you to test out, from all the way back in August.

4) Kodon is resource heavy - please test out recommended specs before you buy. Windows 7 is currently not supported, for instance, because it has an older version of shader support. (We are trying to bring Win7 back, but we're not there yet)

5) (Added in-app) Please refund the game rather than giving it a negative review, if you misunderstood the terms of the app.

We are very serious about Kodon as a semi-professional alternative and believe it should be the best alternative in VR sculpting when it is done. We realize that the people who've had negative experiences will think this sounds completely out of whack. But just wait..

notes.title: Beta v0.38b is out
notes.content:
Our brilliant supporters have been waiting lfor the good stuff for quite a while. To make the waiting easier, we've scooped together a version that takes the current version and adds some of the new things:

 
[u][b]Multi-object / Scene support[/b][/u]

When you press save now, all objects in the scene will be saved together, in the scale, position, angle etc that they have at the point of saving. When you load a scene, the scene will be loaded as separate objects (this is also true in Blender and other 3D programs).

Note: Scene save does not yet subtract / merge / join. You will have to use Blender join or other tools to make one coherent shape for 3D printing.


[u][b]Geometric sculpting support[/b][/u]

Press New Object and choose Geometric sculpting. You will see a small sample of the upcoming geometric sculpting algorithm.

Note: Not with unlimited polygons, mirror, symmetry, angle/grid guides quite yet. It's coming! Until it is ready, try combining several objects.


[u][b]How to switch to beta:[/b][/u]

Rightclick Kodon in Steam, go to the "Betas" tab, piull down and choose "beta -", apply / close window and start Kodon. The game should auto-update to beta.

Feedback is as usually much appreciated. Keep in mind this is a beta with "sample features" that do not represent the final result.

notes.title: Kodon Early Access v0.35 - optimization + "cut" tool + autosmooth
notes.content:
Some bugfixes and some new features from our main codebranch. Most important are the autosmooth and "cut"-tool.

"Autosmooth":

Autosmooth will let you set an angle - every detail sharper than this angle will be slowly cut away when you release the trigger. This can be used to reduce coarse detail, to create certain organic textures from noise, or to round off shapes.

Autosmooth has been wrapped with "autojoin" into a feature called "auto-reduce" which can be turned on and off.

The cut tool:

"Cut" works by slicing away everything above the cutting surface. This tool has replaced the "flatten" tool in the tool cycle, and is a potent rough sculpting tool until the upcoming features are out.

Still some beta issues here, so get ready to "undo". ;)

Important change: Both "cut" and "flatten" will now lock to the plane you start drawing at, allowing you to easily create completely flat details.

Another important change is that neither cut, flatten nor smoothen will now subdivide (since their goal is a flattened surface) - this will save you a lot of polys.

Other changes:
* A new, symmetric "egg" shape for head designs
* Indicator for maximum polygons
* "Call menu" will now reset the menu, the sculpting object and the light in a fixed spot around you.
* Some menu redesign
* Various bugfixes and optimizations (among other for "Redo")

notes.title: Kodon Early Access v0.3 - major optimizations
notes.content:
This update brings a completely new sculpting algorithm, and a new mirror, with a combination of GPU, multicore CPU and other optimizations. Please go to Kodon -> Options and see if you can run a higher quality setting (restart to take effect)

Why the lag in v0.2, and why the delay?

To put it short, we had a HUGE issue with a combination of SteamVR, Unity and the new optimization techniques, stepping all over each others territory. It was a problem nobody at Valve or Unity really appeared to could help us with, which made it really stressful.

We've been at it really hard for the last weeks, the plan (as some of you might remember) was to introduce new techniques for rough sculpting, but unfortunately the lag issues people were experiencing drove us to upgrade the sculpting algorithm first.

So to put it short, this update:

* Was a lot of work...!
* Delayed some of our promises
* Contains a huge upgrade of the sculpting algorithm, which increases precision and quality in pretty much everything. The "Max" category should now be within reach of many of you.
* Using GPU and multicore in all complex operations should fix most lag situations.

Would love to know about any bugs or remaining lag issues, or to which degree this update fixed Kodon for you.

Stay tuned for the rough shaping algorithm / shape synth coming up soon!

notes.title: Beta branch now live
notes.content:
Awaiting the next major version, due to feedback from eager supporters, a beta branch has been added. This beta branch will be both a considerable upgrade from the current main version, and it is also going to be continuously updated with new candy as we make it in the following weeks.

NOTE - to avoid any misunderstandings and disappointments:

This beta does NOT include any of the following features from the upcoming major version:

1) Revamped sculpting algorithm (heavily optimized / bugfixes / noise and spots)
2) Shape synthesizer (a simple way to create basic geometric shapes)
3) Multi-object operations (saving many object as one)

We know you are waiting for these, but they are not quite ready for release for a few weeks yet, thus they have not been included into the beta.

However, the beta does include the following:

1) Undo / Redo feature
2) Revamped GUI
3) An experimental desktop based edit mode that starts up if your VR headset isn't found. (This is not meant as a Sculptris, more as a testing tool -  however, we'd love ideas and feedback on the potential usefulness of it)
4) Size / power adjustment
5) A vertex mode to edit individual vertices

And more is to come.

Looking forward to your, as always, very useful feedback!

**HOW-TO:** To switch to beta versions on Steam games, right click the game in your library, press "Properties", go to the "BETAS" tab and choose "beta" in the "would like to opt into" dropdown menu, and closing the window. Steam should start downloading the beta. The change is always reversible by going back in and choosing "NONE" in the same dropdown menu - the normal version should start downloading.

We would like to organize suggestions in http://www.reddit.com/r/kodon . The advantage of Reddit for this purpose, is that the vote system is pretty good to filter by popularity.

Hope to see some of you there, or at least your votes!

The next major version (July) will of course be fixing bugs, adding some optimization, an undo function and all these more "obvious" features.

But more importantly, some much wanted features will be added. To see them, put your personal spin on how these are going to work, or post suggestions about stuff we should make in stead, head over to Reddit /r/kodon.

Dont be scared that it is a little empty - that only means more eyes for your suggestions :)

notes.title: Information gained, and plans for the upcoming period
notes.content:
Lessons:

People expect more features from Kodon than they do from more casual painting programs, which I think they should! Most reviewers have pointed out the early stage of the program, and are interested in which direction we will be going.

Kodon will aim for a semi-pro type of application. It will offer you ways of using the Vive to create content, but will still be accessible and fun to use. We are listening to the feedback and trying to create the optimal solutions to realize the features people want.

We have also learnt that not all hands are built for the upside-down controller, so this has been made into an option. Very useful. Keep giving feedback!

The main job so far has been the sculpting algorithm, making a GUI and so on. This means that new features can now be ticking in.

The future:

June will be used to quickfix any bugs and issues people will be having, while working on the next major version.

The next version will be released in July, and aims to address the "professional" features many are expecting from the program. I think people are going to enjoy the next iteration.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Now Available on Steam Early Access - Kodon
notes.content:
Kodon is Now Available on Steam Early Access!

Watch an object obediently melt, mold and bend in your hands. Map up your room to work on physical desks and tables. Artists can sculpt high quality models with little or no instruction. Models are saved as .obj, for easy use in Unity, Unreal 3D, ZBrush, Blender and so on.
